name: Mobile MCP
description: Lets agents automate native iOS and Android apps on simulators, emulators, and real devices through one MCP server, using accessibility trees or screenshots.

skills.name: Device Management
skills.description: Lists available simulators, emulators, and real devices, and reads or sets screen size, orientation, GPS location, and clipboard.

skills.name: App Management
skills.description: Lists, installs, launches, terminates, and uninstalls apps from .apk, .ipa, or .app files using bundle IDs or package names.

skills.name: Screen Interaction
skills.description: Lists on-screen UI elements, taps, long-presses, swipes, types text, and presses hardware buttons to drive native app flows.

skills.name: Logs And Crashes
skills.description: Collects live device logs from logcat or the iOS unified log and lists or reads crash reports stored on the device.
